feed.title: NPR Topics: World
feed.subtitle: NPR world news, international art and culture, world business and financial markets, world economy, and global trends in health, science and technology. Subscribe to the World Story of the Day podcast and RSS feed.

entry.title: What we know about war plans that Trump and Netanyahu are drawing up
entry.summary: Could the U.S. and Israel be on the verge of launching a new attack on Iran? President Trump and Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu have been suggesting that's on the table.

entry.title: Greetings from the Brazil-Argentina border, where waterfalls are flowing at near-record rates
entry.summary: The Iguazú Falls span more than a mile across both countries. A rain-soaked October, which scientists link to the Super El Niño, has sent near-record volumes of water surging over the towering cliffs.

entry.title: U.S., Israel may attack Iran post-elections. And, SpaceX and Tesla consider merging
entry.summary: The U.S. and Israel are planning for a possible post-elections attack on Iran, an anonymous source tells NPR. And, Elon Musk considers merging his companies SpaceX and Tesla.

entry.title: Former U.S. Ambassador to Ukraine William Taylor on Trump's embrace of Russia
entry.summary: NPR's Steve Inskeep asks former U.S. Ambassador to Ukraine William Taylor about President Trump's embrace of Russia as envoy Steve Witkoff visits Moscow after meeting Ukraine's Volodymyr Zelenskyy.

entry.title: See how Big Tech is transforming Spain's landscape
entry.summary: A drought-stricken region of northeast Spain has become a focus for American companies searching for locations to place their data centers.

entry.title: U.S. and Israel are planning for a possible attack on Iran, source tells NPR
entry.summary: The U.S. and Israel are preparing plans for a possible attack on Iran in early November, after the U.S. midterm elections, a person briefed on war planning told NPR. Iran said it is prepared.

entry.title: Kara Swisher on Elon Musk: 'He's unelected, unaccountable, enormously wealthy'
entry.summary: As Elon Musk considers merging Tesla and SpaceX, tech journalist Kara Swisher examines his business strategy, growing political influence and power over the war in Ukraine.

entry.title: Bukele says military operation launched to rescue Salvadorans held by gangs in Haiti
entry.summary: El Salvador's President Nayib Bukele said Wednesday he had launched a military operation to rescue four Salvadoran aviation technicians kidnapped by gangs in Haiti.

entry.title: North Korea says it will resume propaganda broadcasts across border into South Korea
entry.summary: North Korea plans to resume anti-Seoul propaganda broadcasts along the heavily armed border with South Korea, leader Kim Jong Un's sister said, reviving a psychological warfare campaign.

entry.title: AIPAC halts endorsements and direct contributions to candidates
entry.summary: The pro-Israel lobbying group and influential political funder announced it would no longer endorse candidates or give directly to campaigns. AIPAC's affiliated super PAC, though, will continue.
